config.confidence_set: Invert plus-one Monte Carlo upper-tail tests of the Gaussian profile-REML score difference at every rho, keeping p_rho > gamma. Independent simulations at each candidate rho. All components retained; empty set conservatively becomes full grid and is counted.
config.error_budget: 0.005 nuisance exclusion plus 0.045 simple-null rejection; p_BB=min(1,max_C p_rho + 0.005), tested at 0.05. No independence between data-derived C and trend statistic is assumed. Finite-grid Gaussian model only.

nuisance_screen.note: Monte Carlo diagnostic tolerance, not a new nuisance error budget or proof of conditional-on-cache validity.

config.acceptance: Unchanged double_bootstrap_research.json acceptance object, all cache/scenario screens; zero numerical failures; additional nuisance screen required. Misspecification failures prohibit broad application release.
config.finite_grid_limit: No continuous-rho guarantee. Off-grid and outside-grid trials are stresses, not covered by the finite-grid theorem.
config.stopping_rule: One fixed experiment, no parameter search after evaluation. On failure recommend descriptive-only use of existing Phase 3 outputs; further experimentation requires a new scientific decision.

acceptance_unchanged.note: Approximate nominal targets plus prior minimum screens; not automatic release. No post-result tuning.

accounting: Four independent cache/panel units. Trends and methods paired within noise panel; separate nuisance/pivot calibration streams. Wilson intervals conditional on one cache; cluster-t ranges have only four units.
decision_if_failed: Stop method search; recommend existing descriptive-only Phase 3 outputs. No inference or Phase 5 without review.
